science.title: Succumbing to certainty is a failure in science
science.summary: Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03837-yResearchers can face pressure from policymakers and politicians to provide single, definitive answers to complex challenges. They should resist, says Andy Stirling.

science.title: Just eight universities dominate Nobel and other top economics prizes
science.summary: Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03333-3Economics is the outlier — top prizes in science, engineering and other social sciences go to researchers at a greater variety of institutions.

science.title: Self-assembling nanocarriers show promise for delivering CRISPR to tumors and slowing growth
science.summary: A self-assembling supramolecular nanocarrier protects Cas9 RNPs from degradation, enhances systemic delivery and preferential tumor accumulation, and enables pH-responsive intracellular release. Developed by researchers at the Institute of Science Tokyo, this platform achieved a 37.2% indel frequency at the luciferase target locus in HeLa-Luc tumor tissue in mice, compared with 1.5% with free RNPs
